reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Endpoint.TLS.CAOptional: ConsulCatalog provider `endpoint.tls.CAOptional` option has been removed in v3, as TLS client authentication is a server side option…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Any endpoint.tls.caOptional configuration present in ConsulCatalog or Nomad provider static configuration will be ignored in v3.
consequence.remediation: Remove the endpoint.tls.caOptional option from the ConsulCatalog and Nomad provider static configuration sections.

proposed.statement: The ConsulCatalog provider endpoint.tls.caOptional option and the Nomad provider endpoint.tls.caOptional option have been removed in v3.
